Off by default. Android starts the foreground VPN service after boot only after you grant VPN permission. Allow notifications to see setup alerts and the Stop action.
Always-on VPN is disabled in this lab build so endpoint metadata is never captured without an explicit start.
VPN settings are not available on this device.

Discord keeps its existing Drover compatibility strategy. WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business use observe-only mode: Drover adds no Discord preamble and does not intentionally alter application datagram payload bytes. This is still a userspace tunnel, so source ports and timing can change. It does not use a remote VPN server or hide your IP address.

Lab warning: the trace stores metadata only — time, protocol, destination IP address, port, and packet size. It never stores packet payloads, messages, audio, or microphone data. Stop Drover before exporting the trace.
